revisions.title: From refutation to training
revisions.body: The whole-or-part dilemma is only the opening test, not the destination. A whole Form would be divided from itself; a part makes largeness, equality, and smallness incoherent. I read the later turns as a widening crisis: regress and likeness undermine the remedies, while separation threatens knowledge—even divine knowledge of human things. I hear the close refusing both denying Forms and defining them too soon. Socrates needs dialectical training.
